PvtResultRow.description:
Represents the columns of a row in a pvt export.

These fields are the current agreed upon standard result. Changes to the fields or
their validation should cause the version defined in the standard result schema to
increase the version number in a way that corresponds to the schema versioning
specification (i.e. they are a patch, minor, or major change).

COMPRESSIBILITY.description: The fluid compressibility this row represents. Optional.
COMPRESSIBILITY.title: Compressibility

GASDENSITY.description: The gas density this row represents. Optional.
GASDENSITY.title: Gasdensity

KEYWORD.description:
Index column. The Eclipse PVT keyword this row is derived from (e.g. PVTO,
PVDG, PVTW). Required.
KEYWORD.title: Keyword

OGR.description: The vaporized oil-gas ratio this row represents. Optional.
OGR.title: Ogr

OILDENSITY.description: The oil density this row represents. Optional.
OILDENSITY.title: Oildensity

PRESSURE.description: The pressure this row represents. Optional.
PRESSURE.title: Pressure

PVTNUM.description: Index column. The PVT region this row represents. Required.
PVTNUM.title: Pvtnum

RS.description: The solution gas-oil ratio this row represents. Optional.
RS.title: Rs

VISCOSIBILITY.description: The viscosibility (viscosity compressibility) this row represents. Optional.
VISCOSIBILITY.title: Viscosibility

VISCOSITY.description: The viscosity this row represents. Optional.
VISCOSITY.title: Viscosity

VOLUMEFACTOR.description: The formation volume factor this row represents. Optional.
VOLUMEFACTOR.title: Volumefactor

WATERDENSITY.description: The water density this row represents. Optional.
WATERDENSITY.title: Waterdensity

PvtResultRow.title: PvtResultRow

description:
Represents the resultant pvt parquet file, which is naturally a list of rows.

Consumers who retrieve this parquet file must read it into a json-dictionary
equivalent format to validate it against the schema.
title: PvtResult
